verification.title: Candidate verification queue
verification.description: Review candidate evidence against the profile entry it supports. Approve it, or reject it with a reason the candidate can act on.

dialog.title: Review candidate evidence
dialog.claimMissing: The linked profile entry was removed.
dialog.approveText: The check counts for the candidate's profile, and recruiters see a tick. The candidate gets an email.
dialog.rejectText: The candidate sees the reason by email and on the Verification page, and can send new evidence.
dialog.decidedNow: Decision saved and emailed to the candidate.

accounts.title: Account review queue
accounts.description: Approve, reject or suspend recruiter accounts after checking the company record and the KYC documents.
accounts.empty: No recruiter accounts with this status.

dialog.title: Review recruiter account
dialog.noActions: No decision is available for this account until the recruiter resubmits.

approved.title: Approve this recruiter?
approved.text: The recruiter workspace opens and the default pipeline stages are created. The recruiter gets an email.

reactivate.title: Reactivate this recruiter?
reactivate.text: The recruiter can sign in again and their published jobs return to candidates. The recruiter gets an email.

rejected.title: Reject this application?
rejected.text: The recruiter sees the reason by email and on the status page, and can fix the details and resubmit.

suspended.title: Suspend this recruiter?
suspended.text: The recruiter is signed out, their jobs disappear from candidates and they get an email with the reason.

dialog.reasonHint: Up to {{max}} characters. Recorded with the decision and in the audit log.
dialog.decidedNow: Decision saved and emailed to the recruiter.
